purpose: Current 53-stock Binance TradFi RTH entry timing A/B/C comparison

comparison.shared_structure: NYSE official calendar RTH 15m -> RTH 4H/stub + RTH daily
comparison.A_RTH: Current production behavior: exact-touch entry from 09:30 ET onward.
comparison.B_PRE15: Allow exact-touch from 09:15 ET. A pre-open touch fills immediately at planned entry.
comparison.C_PRE15_CONFIRM: If 09:15-09:30 touches first, wait for the 09:30-09:45 RTH candle to close on the favorable side and enter at that close; if confirmation fails, later RTH exact-touch remains eligible.
comparison.entry_fill: Exact touch low <= planned_entry <= high for limit-style fills; C confirmation entry uses the confirming RTH 15m close as actual entry.
comparison.evaluation_start: per symbol after 60 completed RTH daily bars
comparison.management: TP1 30% -> BE; TP2 30% -> TP1; runner 40% confirmed RTH 4H pivot; after entry management observes all Binance 15m
